description: This file defines a class 'HttpSoftPsr17Factory' that extends a base factory class for creating PSR-17 HTTP message objects, specifically tailored for the HttpSoft message library. It sets class properties that specify the concrete class names for response, stream, and server request creation.

classes.name: HttpSoftPsr17Factory
classes.description: A factory class extending Psr17Factory to specify particular HttpSoft implementations for PSR-17 message creation.
